the SAME three keys were 2026-09-29-59b8fc; 177835's close: they stay findings by the 09-27 c989c6 design, all 3 are now frozen as live must-fires; no price moves: no recipe line is costed at these cells (recipe lines cost at the Walmart cells: Bella Sun Luci in olive oil 0.6153/oz, Great Value Mayonnaise 0.099/oz)

audit-ingredient-identity.ps1 header lines 31-34: a key not in its mark is a RISE and exits 2; a fall is spoken and -Tighten records only falls; so a deliberately kept finding can never enter the mark and re-pages every day
items.root_cause: the ratchet has no road for a REVIEWED finding: a key the triage decided to keep (proof of form owned by 2026-09-29-465acc) is indistinguishable from a new one, so the detector re-raises the same RISE daily and every close returns

root_fix.what: a reviewed-key list with owner and expiry: a RISE whose key is reviewed and unexpired prints KNOWN (owner id) and does not exit 2
root_fix.exact_change: the cell mark gains reviewed: [{key, owner, until, why}], written only by a new -Review <key> -Owner <queue id> -Until <date> switch (never by a plain run, og-11); the RISE set is the unmarked keys minus unexpired reviewed keys; an expired review re-raises; print the reviewed count beside rises. Seed the three keys owned by 2026-09-29-465acc with a 14-day expiry.

items.leaves_open: the form question itself (oil-packed vs dry at Family Fare and Hy-Vee; olive-oil mayo as mayonnaise) stays with 2026-09-29-465acc

prevention.what: the emitting check distinguishes reviewed findings from new ones, with an expiry so a review cannot become permanent silence

blast_radius.measured_by: detector-only change; no product routing or recipe cost moves (the three cells cost no recipe line)
names: California Sun Dry Sun Dried Tomatoes Julienne Ct
blast_radius.risk: a review could hide a real new defect in the same cell; the key carries store AND product (header line 21), so a different product in the cell is still a RISE

evidence: capture-run-daily-2026-09-30.log: pushed on attempt 1, then EDGE STALE after the 10x30 s poll (edge 2026-09-29T11:02:12, HEAD bdc4e9a92 2026-09-30T08:09:40); fetched 2026-10-01 with a cache-busting query: edge generated 2026-09-30T08:09:40, equal to origin/main's committed feed

items.resolution_note: The smp-feed edge check now waits up to 20 minutes (10x30s then 15x60s) before paging and records every wait in grocery/out/edge-deploy-latency.log, so the bar can be set from a distribution. Ported from the parked 2026-09-30 fix.

items.deviation: Closed no-code by the reviewer as a slow deploy, but triage/2026-09-30-unlanded already held the root fix for this RETURN (the 5-minute page was a bar nobody measured): Wait-EdgeServesPushed polls up to 20 minutes and logs every wait to out/edge-deploy-latency.log. Ported onto origin by the follow-up session of 2026-10-01 (cherry-picks of 1476cb604 and 4b18be788, without their unlanded 09-30 plan file).

items.subject: Automation silent-death: TASK FAILED (TC Daemon Battery 0230)
evidence: Get-ScheduledTaskInfo: last 2026-10-01 09:20:54 result 2 (hourly repetitions replay the 05:25:53 rc=2 run via run-once-a-day)

daemon-battery-2026-10-01.log: DAEMON-BATTERY-COMPLETE commit=172089bb1 exit=2 cases=568 removed=1 added=16 status=0 hard=2: (a) 1 case name in the pinned reference did not run: MUST FIRE  the writer is NOT on an opus tier... (still line 533 of hunt_daemon_selftest.names.txt on origin/main); (b) red case MUST FIRE  the dossier carries NO row CONTENTS

daemon-battery-2026-09-30.log had only (a); git log: e73a611bf 2026-09-29 15:42 Daemon battery: pin every agent to Opus 5.5 Medium instead of the writer off opus renamed the case without updating the pinned names list; (b) appeared between the 09-30 and 10-01 runs

surface_fix.what: update the pinned names list for the renamed case and fix the dossier red
surface_fix.exact_change: replace line 533 with the case name e73a611bf introduced; bisect origin/main between the 09-30 and 10-01 battery commits for the dossier case and fix its cause (not the case)

items.root_cause: the daemon battery runs only nightly: run-gates skips it because it takes minutes, so a commit that renames a case or reddens one lands ungated and the first evidence is a nonzero scheduled task the next morning

root_fix.what: run the battery at push time only for pushes that touch its inputs, through run-gates' keyed-input mechanism
root_fix.exact_change: register the battery as a keyed gate whose input key is meal-prep/pipeline/hunt_daemon*.py + hunt_daemon_selftest.names.txt (+ declared lib inputs, og-45, then -VerifyDeclared), so it runs (388-677 s) on those pushes and replays its verdict on every other; state the cost in the commit

items.leaves_open: other long suites run-gates skips are not covered by this keying (not counted here); a TASK FAILED for a different task is a different defect each time

prevention.what: the change that breaks the battery is refused at push instead of being found by the nightly task

blast_radius.measured_by: not a matching change; scope is pushes touching the daemon files
blast_radius.risk: adds 6-11 minutes to a push that touches the daemon; zero to every other push (keyed replay)

items.resolution_note: Battery red since e73a611bf renamed a pinned case into 13 per-agent tier pins without repinning, plus a non-hermetic dossier case that matched "47" inside a random temp-dir name. Names list repinned (568), fixture values made unmatchable by a temp name, and the battery now runs at push (hunt-daemon.py --selftest-gate) keyed on its declared inputs. Proof: --selftest-gate printed 0 removed, 0 added and SELF-TEST PASS; the same battery against the pre-fix list printed 1 removed and the not-run verdict (numeric exit codes not captured: PS 5.1 Start-Process); run-daemon-battery -SelfTest 15/15 exit 0; -VerifyDeclared exit 0. full_suite: deferred-to-land.
items.premise_verified: yes: ops\out\logs\daemon-battery-2026-10-01.log reads DAEMON BATTERY RED, 2 hard: names.txt line 533 (renamed by e73a611bf into per-agent tier pins; 16 added, 1 removed) and the dossier case got leaked=["47"]
items.deviation: (1) The dossier red was not a regression to bisect: a 30-run probe found the "47" in the dossier's quoted mkdtemp dir (daemon-wave-47j59gce, 1 of 30 runs). The case planted 613/47 and substring-matched; the planted values now carry a decimal point (613.25, 47.75), which no mkdtemp name can hold (20 clean runs). (2) The keyed gate is hunt-daemon.py --selftest-gate, a new flag equal to --selftest plus --names-diff against the committed names list, registered through run-gates $pyArg (hunt-daemon.py left $pySkip; hunt_daemon_selftest.py stays skipped so the battery never runs twice). Declared inputs: meal-prep\pipeline\*.py, the names list, .claude\agents\*.md, grocery\ingredient-queue.ps1; -VerifyDeclared VERIFIED, 51 probes. run-gates itself was not run (the orchestrator's landing runs it).
